newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel closes border crossing over shooting.
newsitem.headline: Israel closes border crossing over shooting.

text.p: Israel closed a border crossing between the West Bank and Jordan for several hours on Tuesday while heavy gunfire was heard in the area, witnesses and the army said.
An Israeli army spokesman said Jordanian soldiers opened fire after noticing something suspicious on their side of the border but no one was hurt.

"According to initial reports, a Jordanian force that spotted suspicious movement on the Jordanian side near the Allenby bridge shot several bursts of automatic fire and green flares in the direction of the sighting," the spokesman said.
"There were no injuries and no damage. The Allenby border crossing and will be reopened in the morning." he said.

Witnesses said earlier the gunfire lasted several hours near the Allenby bridge linking Jordan with the West Bank. Israeli officials closed the border at around 7:30 p.m. (1630 GMT), the witnesses said.
